visual_enhancers.mood_background: CSS-only living background. Place a fixed div behind content. Use 2-3 extremely soft radial gradients with massive blurs (blur-[120px] or blur-[160px]) and very low opacity (10-15%). Animate via slow CSS keyframes (15-20s duration) drifting gently to reflect VERA's state. It must be completely serene and NOT compete with information.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For action cards: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/[0.06]. This mimics Apple Vision Pro elegant depth.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Avoid hard drop shadows. Use ambient glows for active/priority elements.

components.Sidebar: Apps: Hoy (active indicator), Propiedades, Operaciones, Studio. User chip bottom-left (Valentina). No heavy active backgrounds; use a subtle left border (primary color) and white text for active, dim text for inactive.
components.Header: Human greeting ('Buen día, Valentina.') with a language-based summary ('Hay 3 temas que requieren tu atención.'). No KPI blocks.

anatomy: 2. ¿Por qué importa? (Impact): The value at stake.
3. ¿Qué recomienda VERA? (Action): The AI deterministic next step.
4. [ Resolver ahora ] (Button): The explicit resolution trigger.
RecommendationCard.style: Glassmorphism surface. Cleanly structured. Add a subtle vertical indicator line on the left mapping to the priority tier color (Red/Yellow/Green). Give breathing room (p-6 or p-8).
RecommendationCard.button: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). For primary actions: bg-text-primary text-text-inverse hover:bg-gray-200. Do not overuse the #F6E63A yellow for every button; reserve yellow for absolute primary system actions to keep it premium.

components.EmptyState: Cared-for empty state: 'Todo al día. No hay acciones prioritarias por ahora.' Centered, serene, deeply muted text to reflect calm.

motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up (opacity 0 -> 1, translateY 10px -> 0) over 0.6s. Gives the feeling VERA 'was already working' before the user arrived.
motion.interactions: Smooth subtle scaling (scale-95) on button press. Explicit targeted transitions (e.g. transition-colors, transition-transform) over 200ms.

user_avatar.description: Professional modern woman portrait in dark studio lighting for Valentina's user chip.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use Shadcn UI or any external component libraries. Build exclusively with custom React components and Tailwind CSS (VERA UI Kit).
STRICTLY use .js and .jsx extensions. Do not use TypeScript.
NO KPIs, NO dashboard widgets, NO charts. 'Hoy' is an operational inbox organized purely by priority actions.
NEVER use the word 'Error'. Use 'Próximo paso', 'Recomendación', 'Oportunidad', 'Atención', or 'Listo'.
BANNED: sci-fi tropes (robots, circuits, hexagons, aggressive neon). Design for 'future elegant' (Apple Vision Pro, Linear, Framer).
BACKGROUND RULES: The background must be CSS-only (no images) and reflect VERA's 'mood' via extremely subtle, slow-moving radial gradients with massive blurs. Never distract from content.
GLASSMORPHISM: Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for surfaces with content underneath. Use backdrop-blur + slight white opacity (bg-white/[0.02]).
COLORS: Only use the design tokens mapped in Tailwind config. Primary color is #F6E63A. Dark theme is strictly enforced.
TESTING: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. data-testid="resolve-now-button").
ANIMATIONS: Do not apply `transition-all`. Specify explicitly (e.g., `transition-colors duration-200`). Ensure a smooth entrance choreography.
